Use the app\'s Share button → iofast instead.
Notifications are off, so capture results show as short pop-ups instead.
Capture the link of what is on screen
Saves the link of the page or post on screen (Chrome, Samsung Internet, YouTube, X, Instagram) and sends it to your PC. Needs iofast URL capture turned on.
Press your accessibility shortcut to capture the link on screen.

Side + Volume up keys: Settings → Accessibility → Advanced settings → Side and Volume up keys → tick iofast (the URL capture service) and nothing else, then press Side + Volume up together on a page or post. The app in front stays as it is. If a press ever turns URL capture off, untick iofast and tick iofast capture instead: it also works, but YouTube may shrink to a small window.
